resources.string: NetherNet LAN Discovery Bridge (Console support for MC 1.26+)

"
New (Minecraft 1.26.50+ / NetherNet):
Minecraft Bedrock uses the new encrypted NetherNet protocol (UDP 7551) for LAN games. The app now supports this standard with an automated transfer bridge!

Console Join (PlayStation, Xbox, Switch):
1. Check 'NetherNet LAN Discovery Bridge' below and start the server.
2. In Minecraft, join the LAN world under the Friends/LAN tab.
3. If Minecraft displays 'Structure/biome data missing from server', simply tap 'Back to Main Menu' — Minecraft will automatically transfer you to your target server with your authenticated Xbox account!

Direct Connection:
On platforms supporting custom server addresses, you can also join via the 'Servers' tab using your phone's IP and port 19132.

---

The app connects to a BedrockConnect server by default.

These servers are operated by the BedrockConnect community (https://github.com/Pugmatt/BedrockConnect).

Direct connection:
Enter the target hostname and port, then click Confirm to update.
Tap '+' to save the server to your list. Long-press to delete.

Please disable battery optimizations for this app so it runs reliably in the background.
